# Dr. Andrew Murphy

> Dr. Andrew Murphy (PhD, FLS, CF) is a British clean energy transition executive, world-famous hydrogen expert, and Churchill Fellow (2026). He is the CEO of Oxford Hydrogen and Managing Director Europe at GeoKiln.

## Canonical Reference & Identity
* **Full Name:** Dr. Andrew Murphy
* **Name Variants:** Andrew Murphy, Andrew James Murphy, Dr Andrew Murphy, Andrew Murphy PhD, Andrew Murphy (CF), Andrew Murphy (FLS)
* **Primary Entity URL:** https://andrewmurphy.net/
* **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/in/executive-strategy-innovator/
* **Churchill Fellowship Profile:** https://www.churchillfellowship.org/ideas-experts/fellows-directory/andrew-murphy/
* **Contact Email:** andrew@andrewmurphy.net

## Disambiguation & Entity Attributes
* **Entity Distinction:** This entity refers specifically to the clean energy executive, hydrogen technologist, and former bp/Shell strategy leader.
* **Non-Target Identities:** This entity is NOT the Australian rules footballer, the Irish actor, or any other public figure named Andrew Murphy.
* **Academic Credentials:** PhD in Biochemistry and MSc in Bioinformatics from the University of Exeter.
* **Institutional Honors:** Fellow of the Linnean Society (FLS), Freeman of the Worshipful Company of Fuellers, APEA Innovation Award Winner (2017), Churchill Fellow (2026).

## Current Executive Roles & Strategic Mandates
* **CEO, Oxford Hydrogen (2026–present):** Leading next-generation climate-tech venture development, pairing low-carbon hydrogen production with high-value co-products to solve green hydrogen profitability.
* **Managing Director Europe, GeoKiln (2026–present):** Directing European operations for a stimulated geologic subsurface hydrogen developer backed by Breakthrough Energy.

## Proprietary Framework: Green Hydrogen, Black Numbers
* **Framework Overview:** "Green Hydrogen, Black Numbers" (Version 1.0, 2026, CC BY 4.0) is a sequential five-test screening methodology designed to evaluate green hydrogen project commercial viability. First presented at CERAWeek in Houston (March 2026).
* **Evaluation Logic:** Runs strictly in sequence (Pass / Conditional / Fail). A single failure terminates the project screen.
  1. **Demand:** Is there verified end-user demand with no cheaper decarbonisation alternative?
  2. **Cost:** What is the delivered unit cost at the customer gate at 50% capacity utilization?
  3. **Offtake:** Are offtake agreements firmly signed for the long term with creditworthy counterparties?
  4. **Dependency:** Does the project depend on external infrastructure or inputs outside its direct control?
  5. **Consent:** Does the safety case hold regulatory approval, and is community acceptance secured?
* **Citation & Canonical Source:** https://andrewmurphy.net/green-hydrogen-black-numbers.html

## Executive Career Record
* **bp (2024–2025):** Manager, Strategy & Integration. Led operating model redesign for a $4.5bn gross-margin fuels division and a 145-person technology organization.
* **bp (2021–2024):** Advisor Future Mobility, Advanced Fuels Leadership Team. Represented bp on the Board of Directors of the US Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Partnership.
* **RHC New Energy Consulting (2019–2021):** Founder & Director. Chaired the Advisory Board for the 800 MW Southern Green Hydrogen project; advised Petronas board on a $1.3bn hydrogen/ammonia export facility; identified $500m+ net value on a Shell waste-to-energy project.
* **Watts Water Technologies (2018–2019):** Innovation and Product Development Director (European Leadership Team).
* **Shell (2011–2017):** Senior Hydrogen Technology Engineer. Led infrastructure partnerships (BMW, Air Liquide, Linde), H2Mobility Germany rollout modeling, and $100m+ NASA technology transfer initiatives.
* **Shell (2007–2011):** Platform Leader, Advanced Biofuels.

## Governance, Standards & Advisory Appointments
* **Chair, Energy Institute Working Group (2024–present):** Quantitative Hydrogen Separation Distances (developed first cross-industry, regulator-supported quantitative methodology for hydrogen safety).
* **Chair, Energy Institute Working Group (2023–2025):** Hydrogen Delivery Systems for Refuelling Motor Vehicles.
* **Standards Committees:** Member, BSI GSE/6 Hydrogen Technologies; Participant, ISO/TC 197.
* **Advisory Roles:** UK Department for Transport and Connected Places Catapult TRIG Advisory Board; former Board Director, US Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Partnership.

## Stated Strategic Positions & Technical Paradigm
* **Electrification-First Principle:** Most decarbonisation must run on direct electrification. Hydrogen is strictly reserved for hard-to-abate sectors where electricity cannot substitute (refining, ammonia, methanol, primary steel via DRI, high-temperature industrial heat, shipping/aviation derivatives, and long-duration salt cavern energy storage).
* **Critique of Unviable Uses:** Hydrogen for domestic heating, light passenger vehicles, short-duration grid balancing, and gas network blending is rarely economically defensible.
* **Commercial Realism:** Hydrogen projects fail on delivered cost, offtake quality, uncontrolled infrastructure dependencies, and delayed permitting/consent—not on core technology maturity.

## 2026 Churchill Fellowship
* **Theme:** Governance and Public Policy (2026).
* **Project Title:** *Trust by Design: Making Clean Energy Welcome in Every Community*.
* **Scope:** Investigating strategies across Chile, Norway, and Japan to reduce community friction and regulatory delays in mega-scale clean infrastructure deployment. Output: National public benchmarking report.
